payout_quote: For each Eligible Contribution made by a Customer to their Public IRA Account, Public Investing will fund a Match Amount of 1% of the value of such contribution... A $6,000 contribution earns a $60 match, paid as $5.00/month over 12 months.
timing: $60 match on a $6,000 contribution, paid as $5.00/month for 12 months starting ~1 month after the contribution settles
eligibility: Public IRA account in good standing; contribution must be within the IRS annual IRA contribution limit and requires earned income; offer period ongoing since March 24, 2025 until ended by Public
steps: Open a Public IRA account (Traditional or Roth)
Make a $6,000 eligible IRA contribution (within the IRS annual limit; requires earned income)
The 1% match ($60) is credited in 12 monthly $5.00 installments starting about a month after settlement
Keep the funds in the account - withdrawals shrink future monthly match payments
catches: The match DRIBBLES out over 12 months - a $6,000 contribution earns $60 total, paid as $5.00/month. There is no quick lump sum.
This is RETIREMENT money: IRA early withdrawals face taxes plus a 10% penalty (under 59 1/2). This is not spendable cash.
You need EARNED income to contribute to an IRA at all, and you're capped by the IRS annual limit.
Withdrawing funds reduces future monthly match payments - and closing the account kills the remaining match.
Public can change or end the match program at any time (only contributions already settled keep the old terms).
biggest_catch: A $6,000 IRA contribution earns a $60 match that arrives as $5/month for a year - and the money is locked in a retirement account with tax penalties if you touch it early. This is a retirement-saver bonus, not quick cash.

maximize: Contribute early in the calendar year: the 12 monthly $5 payments start about a month after settlement, so a January contribution finishes paying by next February while a December one dribbles for over a year. Every tax year's contribution restarts the 1% clock up to the IRS annual limit - this is the rare signup-style bonus you can harvest again each year you have earned income.
